searchText: I agree Pseudocode aside, I think the list percentiles should be "nearest rank, inclusive" https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Frequency_histogram_and_exclusive_and_inclusive_percentiles_2.png Plus a final extra value at the end of the list for the maximum But maybe what we need is a set of test cases You are right, i wanted to write the nearest rank inclusive version but looks like the check is in the wrong place, should be after the addition. Thanks, i'll fix it :) I made a transaction generator and graphed some dummy results from your API <@!202397237962211328> https://github.com/perama-v/fee-history/blob/main/viz.ipynb It simulates the part of the API where you specify the list of percentiles you are interested in. I also included a comparison of gas-weighted and non-weighted versions. Everything looks good AFAICT. Here is a sample: Where the blue gas-weighted percentile calculation diverges from the yellow count-based method. This is the result of a very large transaction Which can be seen here as the outlier at about 58 gwei/gas So, the API returns the blue rather than the yellow in general It is more of a philosophical design choice. I think it works, and see no obvious problems.
